inputs.name: R2ReportRetentionAdapter.purge.id
inputs.description: The report ID passed through safeId and appended to each reportCloudPrefixes entry with a trailing slash. It controls which report objects purge lists; purge adds no separate ID validation in this adapter.

inputs.name: R2ReportRetentionAdapter.purge.dryRun
inputs.description: When true, matching keys are counted without deletion; when false, the adapter attempts to remove them. Defaults to false.

inputs.name: R2ReportRetentionAdapter.orphans.known
inputs.description: The IDs of reports to keep; candidates whose first path segment is present in this set are excluded. Candidate IDs are checked against /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,100}$/ before this membership check.

inputs.name: R2ReportRetentionAdapter.orphans.cutoff
inputs.description: Inclusive Unix epoch cutoff in milliseconds for orphan eligibility. A candidate must have LastModified and its getTime() must be less than or equal to this value.

inputs.name: R2ReportRetentionAdapter.orphans.dryRun
inputs.description: When true, matching orphan keys are counted without deletion; when false, the adapter attempts to remove them. Defaults to false.

outputs.name: R2ReportRetentionAdapter.fromEnvironment
outputs.description: Returns undefined when r2EvidenceConfig() is falsy; otherwise it constructs and returns an R2ReportRetentionAdapter from that config. The returned adapter is a class instance.

outputs.name: R2ReportRetentionAdapter.purge
outputs.description: Resolves to the count of keys listed beneath safeId(id) for each reportCloudPrefixes entry. With dryRun true it returns that count without removing keys; otherwise removal is attempted before the promise resolves.

outputs.name: R2ReportRetentionAdapter.orphans
outputs.description: Resolves to the count of keys across reportCloudPrefixes whose first path segment passes /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,100}$/, is absent from known, and has LastModified at or before cutoff. With dryRun true the count is returned without removal; otherwise removal is attempted before the promise resolves.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown if a listed object has no Key or its Key is outside the requested prefix, if a truncated listing has no next continuation token, or if a delete response reports per-object errors.
